segments.he: וְהִנֵּה בִּהְיוֹתִי עַל הַסְּפִינָה הַנִּזְכֶּרֶת לְעֵיל שֶׁשָּׂכַרְנוּ, נוֹדַע לָנוּ שֶׁלּא תֵּלֵךְ הַסְּפִינָה עַד לְמָחָר רַק שֶׁבְּיוֹם זֶה כְּפִי הַנִּרְאֶה כְּבָר זָזָה מִמְּקוֹמָהּ, וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה לא הָיָה יָכוֹל רַבִּי אַבְרָהָם לְמָצְאָהּ:
segments.en: And also after his return from Eretz Yisroel — his longing for Eretz Yisroel was still enormous and exceptionally great — with true soul-consuming yearning. As our fathers told us — that when he was in Lemberg he sat with people at the Seudas Shelishis of holy Shabbas — which is the time of Ra'ava d'Ra'avin [the time of times].
